assets.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Precise naturalistic ink and watercolour botanical textbook plate matching strawberry botanical illustrations: fine clean ink linework, delicate textured watercolour, muted golden straw and natural sage green. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, watermark or frame. Genuine transparent alpha background, no exterior glow, halo, shadow or background wash. Landscape canvas at least 1600px wide with at least 8 percent transparent margin all sides. On LEFT one recognisable mature awned bread-wheat ear (Triticum aestivum), compact alternating wheat spikelets on a central rachis, wheat not barley, on its stem with exactly two long narrow leaves. On RIGHT at larger scale exactly ONE open wheat floret, botanical detail, separate from the ear with ample transparent gap. Exactly THREE distinct yellow elongated bilobed anthers dangling at separate positions from three thin curved filaments, not touching or hiding each other. At the centre one small green ovary with exactly TWO feathery branching stigma arms rising from it. Stigma feather branches are green pale sage and visibly different from yellow anthers. Behind these organs the pale straw husks lemma and palea are parted open. Floret occupies enough space to show all three anthers and both feathered stigma branches clearly on a camera push. No extra florets or flowers. All organ bases connect anatomically to the one floret, not a detached diagram of organs. Both parts form one balanced teaching plate.

assets.prompt: Use case scientific-educational.
